verdict.rationale: Granola's docs confirm that signing in connects your calendar so it can pull and show upcoming meeting events. However, nothing in the evidence shows automatic capture or per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get recorded. Per-call-type templates only change how notes are summarised, not which meetings are captured. Missing for 10: explicit Google and Outlook support named in the evidence, automatic capture of calendar meetings, per-meeting-type capture rules, independent corroboration.
